moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: -7
For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

moves.name: Psyshield Bash
moves.description:
Psychic (Physical)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 90
Priority: 0
Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
The user swaps its Ability with the target's Ability. Fails if either the user or the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 5
The power of the target's attack this turn is multiplied by 1.5 (this effect is stackable). Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user or if the ally already moved this turn, but does not fail if the ally is using a two-turn move.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description:
Psychic (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Gravity
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 5 turns, the evasiveness of all active Pokemon is multiplied by 0.6. At the time of use, Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, and Telekinesis end immediately for all active Pokemon. During the effect, Bounce, Fly, Flying Press, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, Splash, and Telekinesis are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. Ground-type attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability can affect Flying types or Pokemon with the Levitate Ability. Fails if this move is already in effect.

moves.name: Psychic Noise
moves.description:
Psychic (Special)
Base Power: 75
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
For 2 turns, the target is prevented from restoring any HP as long as it remains active. During the effect, healing and draining moves are unusable, and Abilities and items that grant healing will not heal the user. If an affected Pokemon uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to restore its HP. Pain Split and the Regenerator Ability are unaffected.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 60
Priority: 0
Causes the target to fall asleep.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 85
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Colbur Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Dark-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Choice Scarf
items.description: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

items.name: Expert Belt
items.description: Holder's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.2x damage.

items.name: White Herb
items.description: Restores all lowered stat stages to 0 when one is less than 0. Single use.

items.name: Quick Claw
items.description: Each turn, holder has a 20% chance to move first in its priority bracket.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opposing Pokemon by 1 stage. Pokemon with the Inner Focus, Oblivious, Own Tempo, or Scrappy Abilities and Pokemon behind a substitute are immune.

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Grass-type moves and raises its Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Grass-type move.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon identifies the held items of all opposing Pokemon.
